§ 716.1 General obligations.
(a) This part establishes special ini-
tial performance standards that apply
in the following special cir-
cumstances—
(1) § 716.2 applies to surface coal min-
ing operations on steep slopes.
(2) § 716.3 applies to surface coal min-
ing operations involving mountaintop
removal.
(3) § 716.4 applies to special bitu-
minous coal mines.
(4) § 716.5 applies to anthracite sur-
face coal mining operations.
(5) § 716.6 applies to surface coal min-
ing operations in Alaska.
(6) § 716.7 applies to surface coal min-
ing operations on prime farmlands.
